name: page-tabs
purpose: The second-level navigation strip of a resource detail page: a full-bleed bar ruled at the bottom, its `Tabs` at the page boundary inset, with room for the actions the whole resource owns on the right (a staged-changes `Tag`, Deploy). It is `Tabs` plus the strip and the actions region, so every detail page stops re-creating the same bar.
useWhen: The top of every resource detail page, under the global header.
An account page split into tabs, such as Billing.
avoidWhen: Tabs inside a card, a drawer or a panel → use `tabs`.
Steps of a flow → use `stepper` or `wizard`.
Navigation between pages of the app → use `sidebar` or `navigation-menu`.
related: tabs` — the tablist it renders; pass one `Tabs.Item` per section in the default slot.
page-header` — the page heading under the strip.
tag` and `button` — the usual content of the `actions` slot.
bestPractices: Bind `v-model` to the route (or a ref) and render the section below from it.
Keep the labels to one word where possible.
Put only actions that apply to the whole resource in `actions`; page-level actions go in the `page-header`.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: One Tabs.Item per section of the resource.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: The actions the whole resource owns, on the right of the strip: a staged-changes Tag, Deploy.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import PageTabs from '@aziontech/webkit/page-tabs'
  import Tabs from '@aziontech/webkit/tabs'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const activeTab = ref('overview')
  const tabs = [
    { value: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
    { value: 'build', label: 'Build' },
    { value: 'deployments', label: 'Deployments' },
    { value: 'variables', label: 'Variables' },
    { value: 'rules', label: 'Rules' },
    { value: 'logs', label: 'Logs' },
    { value: 'metrics', label: 'Metrics' },
    { value: 'settings', label: 'Settings' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <PageTabs v-model="activeTab">
    <Tabs.Item
      v-for="tab in tabs"
      :key="tab.value"
      :value="tab.value"
      :label="tab.label"
    />
  </PageTabs>
</template>

examples.name: WithActions
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import PageTabs from '@aziontech/webkit/page-tabs'
  import Tabs from '@aziontech/webkit/tabs'
  import Tag from '@aziontech/webkit/tag'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const activeTab = ref('overview')
  const tabs = [
    { value: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
    { value: 'deployments', label: 'Deployments' },
    { value: 'settings', label: 'Settings' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <PageTabs v-model="activeTab">
    <Tabs.Item
      v-for="tab in tabs"
      :key="tab.value"
      :value="tab.value"
      :label="tab.label"
    />
    <template #actions>
      <Tag
        severity="warning"
        size="small"
        label="2 changes"
      />
      <Button
        label="Deploy"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
        icon="pi pi-cloud-upload"
      />
    </template>
  </PageTabs>
</template>
